issues.description: The UML diagram in the problem statement names the class 'Course', while the rest of the exercise (problem text, template, and solution) consistently refers to the class as 'Lecture'. This identifier mismatch between the UML and the actual class name can confuse students about which class to implement and where the attributes/methods belong.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the UML diagram in problem_statement.md to name the class 'Lecture' (instead of 'Course') so it matches the class name used in the template and solution. Ensure the UML attributes and method signatures remain the same but are placed under 'Lecture' to avoid student confusion.
